parameters.query:
-- The escalation row was written by the tool BEFORE this webhook fired:
-- a dropped escalation is the worst outcome in the system, so the record
-- must not depend on the network. This node only enriches the envelope with
-- the on-call number and the caller's number for routing.
SELECT COALESCE(l.escalation_number, '') AS escalation_number,
       COALESCE(l.business_name, '')     AS business_name,
       COALESCE(c.from_phone, '')        AS caller_phone
FROM escalations e
LEFT JOIN locations l USING (location_id)
LEFT JOIN calls c USING (call_id)
WHERE e.escalation_id = $1::bigint;
